notes.subject: mosadi wa maatla
notes.rationale: אשת חיל: 'mosadi wa maatla' (a swana le sesole) kgahlanong le 'mosadi wa maitirelo' goba 'mosadi wa boholwa'; Seheberu se šomiša lentšu la sesole.

notes.subject: dipeninime
notes.rationale: מפנינים: dipereleng goba mahlaku a mmala; lentšu le sa hlaka gore ke sefe.

notes.subject: חיל
notes.rationale: Lentšu le tee le bolela maatla, sesole le boholwa — setshwantšho se gabedi se lahlegilego ka go Sepedi.

translation: Mosadi wa maatla — ke mang yo a ka mo hwetšago? Gomme boleng bja yena bo lego kgakala go feta dipeninime.

tokens.gloss: gomme bo lego kgakala go feta
